descriptions.zh:
## 功能描述
指纹提取能力可以对输入的一张手指拍照图像自动定位其手指区域，并生成二值化黑白按压式指纹图像。

> - 您可以进入[在线咨询](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2)获取在线人工帮助。
- 当前能力可在视觉智能开放平台有完整的免费产品体验，您可以单击[立即试用](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=ExtractFingerPrint)对该能力进行更直观试用以及在线购买。
- 阿里云视觉智能开放平台视觉AI能力API接入、接口使用或问题咨询等，请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们。

## 应用场景
线上信息采集：在云上办案过程中，上传当事人利用手机拍摄的自己的拇指图像，可通过指纹提取能力，生成一张按压式指纹图像，以此作为当事人的信息进行备案，让远程办案成为可能。

## 特色优势

- 智能定位：通过深度学习算法，实现手指区域的智能定位，降低手机拍摄采集的难度。
- 支持多角度拍摄：支持处理任意角度的手指图片，降低指纹采集难度。
- 精准还原：精准还原手指指纹，纹理视觉效果和真实按压指纹无差异。

## 接入指引
1. 注册阿里云账号：打开[阿里云官网](https://www.aliyun.com)，在阿里云官网右上角，单击**立即注册**，按照操作提示完成账号注册。
2. 开通能力：请确保您已开通[人脸人体服务](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody)，若未开通服务请[立即开通](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open)。开通服务后请[提交申请](https://vision.console.aliyun.com/cn-shanghai/applyopen/facebody/ExtractFingerPrint)，申请通过后[购买QPS](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebodyqps_public_cn#/buy)方可使用。

><notice>
本能力仅限企业认证用户开通。更多实名认证操作信息，请参见[实名认证](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html)。
></notice>

3. 创建AccessKey：请确保您已[创建AccessKey](~~175144~~)，如果您使用的是子账号AccessKey，您需要给子账号赋予AliyunVIAPIFullAccess权限，具体操作，请参见[RAM授权](~~145025~~)。
4. 在线调试（可选）：您可以通过[OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/ExtractFingerPrint?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=old)在线调试能力，查看完整的调用示例代码及SDK依赖信息，也可以下载完整的工程。
5. 开发接入步骤：
- 在[SDK总览](~~145033~~)中选择您要接入使用的SDK语言。
- 在对应语言的SDK文档中找到AI类目为人脸人体（facebody）的SDK包进行安装。
- 参考文档中提供的示例代码进行适当修改后调用。

6. 客户端直接调用：该能力常用的客户端调用方式包括以下几种。
- [Web前端直接调用](~~467779~~)
- [小程序场景下直接调用](~~467780~~)
- [Android端直接调用](~~467781~~)
- [iOS端直接调用](~~467782~~)

## 输入限制

- 图像格式：JPG、JPEG、PNG。

- 图像大小：不超过10 MB。

- 图像分辨率：大于640×360像素，小于2560×1440像素。

- 拍摄镜头尽量靠近手指，对角拍摄。

- URL地址中不能包含中文字符。

## 计费说明
关于指纹提取的计费方式及报价，请参见[计费介绍](~~184049~~)。
descriptions.en:
## Feature description
The fingerprint extraction feature automatically locates the finger region in an input photo of a finger and generates a binarized black-and-white pressed fingerprint image.

> - You can join [online consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) to get help from online support.
- You can try this feature for free on the China Vision Intelligence Open Platform. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=ExtractFingerPrint) to experience this feature or purchase it online.
- To consult about API integration, usage, or issues related to the Alibaba Cloud China Vision Intelligence Open Platform, contact us by joining the DingTalk group (23109592).

## Common scenarios
Online information collection: During cloud-based case handling, a party uploads a photo of their thumb taken with a mobile phone. The fingerprint extraction feature generates a pressed fingerprint image that can be used as the party's identity record, making remote case handling possible.

## Benefits

- Intelligent positioning: Uses deep learning algorithms to intelligently locate the finger region, reducing the difficulty of mobile phone-based fingerprint collection.
- Multi-angle shooting support: Supports processing finger images taken from any angle, reducing the difficulty of fingerprint collection.
- Accurate restoration: Accurately restores finger fingerprints with texture visual effects identical to real pressed fingerprints.

## Getting started
1. Create an Alibaba Cloud account: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com), click **Register Now** in the upper-right corner, and follow the instructions to create an account.
2. Activate the feature: Make sure you have activated the [Face and Body service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If you have not activated the service, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open). After activating the service, [commit an application](https://vision.console.aliyun.com/cn-shanghai/applyopen/facebody/ExtractFingerPrint). After the application is approved, [purchase QPS](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebodyqps_public_cn#/buy) to use the feature.

><notice>
This feature is available only to users who verify your identity - Enterprise account. For more information about real-name verification, refer to [Real-name verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).
></notice>

3. Create an AccessKey pair: Make sure you have [created an AccessKey pair](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, grant the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For more information, refer to [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Online debugging (optional): You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/ExtractFingerPrint?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=old) to debug this feature online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the complete project.
5. Development integration steps:
- Select the SDK language you want to use from [SDK overview](~~145033~~).
- Find and install the SDK package for the Face and Body (facebody) category in the corresponding SDK documentation.
- Modify the sample code provided in the References as needed and invoke it.

6. Direct client invocation: Common client invocation methods for this feature include the following.
- [Direct invocation from web frontend](~~467779~~)
- [Direct invocation from mini programs](~~467780~~)
- [Direct invocation from Android](~~467781~~)
- [Direct invocation from iOS](~~467782~~).

## Input limits

- Image format: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.

- Image size: Up to 10 MB.

- Image resolution: Greater than 640 × 360 pixels and less than 2560 × 1440 pixels.

- Position the camera lens as close to the finger as possible and shoot at a diagonal angle.

- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

## Billing description
For information about the billable methods and pricing of fingerprint fetch, refer to [Billing overview](~~184049~~).
